Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets
Markets.summary: US stocks ended higher on Friday as accelerating consumer prices strengthened expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike. Meanwhile, Dell shares surged to a record high and oil prices fell despite concerns over Middle East supply disruptions.

Markets.title: Demat 2.0 will bring instant bond settlement closer, trading after regulation and market readiness: NSDL MD
Markets.summary: NSDL Managing Director Vijay Chandok stated that Demat 2.0 could enable instant bond settlements and tokenized bond delivery using central bank digital currency. However, he noted that wider implementation depends on market readiness and regulatory approvals.

Markets.title: BlackRock private credit fund sees redemption pressure ease in third quarter
Markets.summary: BlackRock's flagship private credit fund experienced lower redemption requests in the third quarter. This decline in withdrawal requests signals easing pressure across the sector and improving market sentiment.

Markets.title: Granules India promoter sells 1.72 crore shares worth Rs 1,500 crore; Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas among investors
Markets.summary: Granules India promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.72 crore shares for approximately Rs 1,500 crore to institutional investors like Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas. The share sale reduced the promoter's stake to 31.08% to fund the second tranche of a preferential issue.

Markets.title: Fed rate-hike bets rise to 85% after hot August inflation data
Markets.summary: Hot August inflation and rising oil prices have caused traders to estimate an 85% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Core consumer prices exceeded economists' forecasts, signaling that inflation is continuing to rise.

Markets.title: Gold climbs on dip buying, Fed hike bets rise after US inflation data
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose over one percent on Friday due to dip buying after finding a short-term floor. Strong U.S. inflation data increased market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week.

Geo-Political.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
Geo-Political.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis claim to have made a major military advance in Yemen and seized the strategic island of Perim. This action tightens their control over the vital Red Sea shipping lane.

Geo-Political.title: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's Princess Astrid has died just two days after attending the funeral of her brother, King Harald. The new king, Haakon VIII, paid tribute to his aunt, praising her warm and dutiful representation of the Royal House.

Geo-Political.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
Geo-Political.summary: Israel announced it has destroyed a major underground Hezbollah base in Lebanon. The blast was so powerful that the U.S. Geological Survey recorded it as the equivalent of a 4.1 magnitude earthquake.

Geo-Political.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
Geo-Political.summary: Sotheby's auction house is selling Princess Diana's famous "revenge dress" on December 9. The garment is expected to fetch between £220,000 and $300,000.

Geo-Political.title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
Geo-Political.summary: A Thai Buddhist monk has been arrested in connection with a suspected three million dollar embezzlement scandal. Police also arrested a female accomplice after the monk, who had taken a vow of celibacy, was filmed having sex with her.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
Geo-Political.summary: AI company Anthropic recently blocked a suspected attempt to use its technology to create biological weapons. This discovery follows previous warnings from a former top researcher regarding the severe existential risks AI poses to humanity.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi urges BRICS to turn its growing economic weight into stronger trade, investment and business partnerships
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged BRICS nations to reduce trade barriers, deepen investments, and secure sea lanes. He also presented India's infrastructure, startups, and digital public infrastructure as drivers of global growth.

Data & Insights.title: Modi meets Pezeshkian amid US-Iran War: Seafarers’ safety in West Asia, BRICS cooperation discussed
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi. They discussed strengthening India-Iran relations, seafarers' safety in West Asia, and cooperation in multilateral forums.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 7.8% Q1 GDP growth ‘above our expectations’, says IMF amid energy price shock
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF reported that India's real GDP grew by 7.8% in Q1 FY27, exceeding expectations despite ongoing energy price shocks. The organization also praised India's improved data transparency and revised GDP estimation methods, highlighting the country's strength as a global growth engine.

Data & Insights.title: In New Delhi, Putin pitches BRICS investment platform, says bloc’s growth outpaces G7 - ‘World is always changing’
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin pitched a new BRICS digital investment platform in New Delhi aimed at mobilizing private-sector funding and boosting economic competitiveness. Highlighting that the bloc's growth now outpaces the G7, Putin emphasized that the global landscape is continually evolving.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: From trade to defence, energy and space - What transpired during Modi-Putin meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin met during the BRICS Summit to review bilateral cooperation. The Ministry of External Affairs stated that they discussed progress across multiple sectors, including trade, defence, energy, and space.

Data & Insights.title: Modi-Putin meet: $100 billion trade target by 2030, nuclear energy, critical minerals likely focus areas, says report
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi and President Putin are expected to set an ambitious bilateral trade target of $100 billion by 2030. Their upcoming meeting will also likely focus on expanding cooperation in nuclear energy and critical minerals.

India.title: 'US, Israel Want To Bully Us, But We Won't Kneel': Iran President In Delhi
India.summary: During a visit to Delhi, Iran's president stated that his country will not submit to pressure from the United States and Israel. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Modi thanked Iran for maintaining high-level participation in BRICS meetings despite difficult circumstances.

India.title: At BRICS Summit, PM Modi, UN Chief Discuss Need To Reform Global Bodies
India.summary: During the BRICS summit, Prime Minister Modi and UN Chief Antonio Guterres discussed the necessity of reforming global institutions. Additionally, Guterres congratulated Modi on India holding the chairship of BRICS for the fourth time.

India.title: On Vande Mataram Row, Congress' 'Stand Upright' Retort To Omar Abdullah
India.summary: The full national song was recently played at a Jammu and Kashmir event, sparking objections from the Congress party. In response to Omar Abdullah, Congress advised critics to stand upright during the song.

India.title: BRICS Summit 2026 LIVE Updates: Putin, Pezeshkian Highlight Issue Of Sanctions At BRICS Business Forum
India.summary: India will host the BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13 as the BRICS Chair for 2026. At the BRICS Business Forum, leaders including Vladimir Putin and Masoud Pezeshkian highlighted the issue of sanctions.

India.title: Putin Takes "40%" Dig At G7, Compares It With BRICS' Contribution To World GDP
India.summary: At the BRICS Business Forum, Russian President Vladimir Putin noted that BRICS now accounts for 40% of the world's GDP, surpassing the G7 nations. He cited this statistic to highlight the shifting global economic landscape over the past five years.

India.title: Delhi Lt Governor Proposes Mandatory Tuberculosis Test For All Hospital Patients
India.summary: The Delhi Lieutenant Governor has proposed making tuberculosis tests mandatory for all hospital patients. This measure aims to help the city meet its lagging targets under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan before the September 30 deadline.

General.title: MPs vote against fresh attempt to legalise assisted dying
General.summary: Members of Parliament have voted against a proposed law to legalise assisted dying. The rejection prevents what would have been one of the biggest societal changes in recent years.

General.title: An extraordinary result - why did MPs reject assisted dying bill this time?
General.summary: MPs rejected a recent assisted dying bill, causing the campaign to lose its current momentum. Supporters of the legislation stated they plan to try again in the future.

General.title: 'Never, ever forget' - America marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
General.summary: America marked the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks with solemn commemoration ceremonies. These events were held at the World Trade Center site in New York, the Pentagon, and Pennsylvania.

General.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
General.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis have reportedly seized the strategic island of Perim. This advance tightens their control over the major shipping lane in the Red Sea.

General.title: How global trade and oil prices could be hit by Houthi advance
General.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have captured territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait. This strategic chokepoint is essential for global shipping and oil transportation.

General.title: UK government rejects 'kill switch' idea for dangerous AI
General.summary: The Cabinet Office, which leads on AI safety, says the UK "cannot simply turn AI off".
